item.title: Leverage Rejection for Growth 🚀 • Request feedback from the interviewer. • Identify skills or experiences to improve. • Use: “I improved my skills by 20% after feedback.” • Update your resume with new achievements. • Practice discussing your growth in interviews. How can you transform feedback into a compelling story of growth? #career #growth #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
